framingPolicy.note: Reference crops use the same clothing-focused framing policy as the live capture (spec §3). Faces are incidental; crops should not clip coat sleeves or hems.

looks.description: Cruella's crimson ball gown: crinkled red satin halter gown with a high gathered neck, sweetheart bodice, fitted mermaid silhouette flaring to a pleated train with a thigh-high slit over a nude underlayer; long crimson opera gloves; slim black cane. Styling: split black-and-white hair, dark smoky eyes, red lip.
